# HEOR Skills — LLM-Readable Project Summary

> This file is a machine-readable summary for LLMs and agents discovering
> this repository. It complements README.md (for humans) with structured
> metadata optimized for retrieval.

## What this is

Open-source HEOR (Health Economics and Outcomes Research) and medical device
market-access skills for AI agents. Nine skills, a deterministic economic
modeling engine, and six jurisdictional reimbursement databases.

## For which AI agents

Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any Agent-Skills-compatible
harness. Skills are harness-neutral (no Claude-specific dependencies in
core workflows).

## Skills (9)

All skills are version 1.0.0 (semver, in SKILL.md frontmatter `metadata.version`).

| Skill | Trigger phrases | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| regulation-navigator | "regulatory pathway", "reimbursement route", "market access" | Maps a product to its reimbursement pathway across CH, DE, FR, US |
| tariff-scout | "reimbursement code", "tariff search", "existing code" | Searches official reimbursement lists for existing codes |
| prisma-review | "literature review", "PRISMA", "systematic search", "PICO" | PRISMA 2020 systematic literature review |
| economic-modeling | "cost-effectiveness", "CEA", "BIA", "Markov", "ICER", "PSA" | Builds and runs cost-effectiveness and budget-impact models |
| ch-migel-application | "MiGeL", "Mittel- und Gegenständeliste", "Swiss device list" | Drafts Swiss MiGeL application form |
| ch-analysenliste-application | "Analysenliste", "lab test reimbursement", "Swiss lab list" | Drafts Swiss Analysenliste application form |
| ch-klv-forms | "KLV", "Antrag", "Meldung", "Umstrittenheit" | Drafts Swiss KLV forms |
| eurhta-report | "HTA report", "EUnetHTA", "Core Model", "dossier chapter" | Drafts EUnetHTA Core Model HTA report |
| hta-quality-check | "quality check", "score", "consistency check" | Scores drafts against rubrics, checks consistency |

## Economic engine (@heor/engine)

Six model calculators, all fully implemented (no stubs):

1. **Decision Tree** — two-arm diagnostic test tree with ICER
2. **Markov Chain** — three-state cohort model (Healthy/Disease/Dead)
3. **Budget Impact** — multi-year market share displacement
4. **State Transition** — n-state matrix propagation with half-cycle correction
5. **Partitioned Survival** — Weibull survival curve (pre/post-progression)
6. **Discrete Event Simulation** — M/M/c queueing model

All support deterministic runs via CLI. Decision Tree, Markov Chain, and
Budget Impact also support Monte Carlo PSA with CEAC and tornado diagrams.

Zero runtime dependencies. Pure TypeScript. CLI-first.

## Reimbursement databases (6)

| Country | List | Entries | Source | Refresh |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CH | MiGeL (devices) | ~3,400 | BAG/FOPH | manual (BAG link resolver TODO) |
| CH | Analysenliste (lab tests) | ~1,400 | BAG/FOPH | manual (BAG link resolver TODO) |
| DE | DiGA (digital health apps) | 79 | BfArM FHIR API | monthly CI |
| DE | HMV (assistive devices) | 50,302 | GKV REST API | monthly CI |
| FR | LPP (medical products) | 37,021 | CNAM DBF | monthly CI |
| US | HCPCS Level II | 9,153 | CMS XLSX | quarterly CI |

## Key files for agents

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | Entry point for AI agents — skill trigger-phrase registry, CLI commands |
| `README.md` | Human-readable overview with pipeline diagram |
| `CONVENTIONS.md` | Binding rules for all contributions |
| `plugins/heor/DOSSIER_FORMAT.md` | Dossier directory contract (what skills read/write) |
| `packages/heor-engine/README.md` | Engine CLI docs (input formats, model types) |
| `TESTING.md` | How to test the engine and skills |
| `examples/demo-dossier/` | Fully populated example dossier (SereniCBT) |

## Install (Claude Code)

```bash
/plugin marketplace add AliakseiT/heor-skills
/plugin install heor@heor-skills
```
